--- keys
TripleClick(1,3)
--- expect
[alpha beta]
gamma delta
epsilon
--- note
A triple click selects the paragraph, which here is the logical line, and
stops at the line end rather than swallowing the newline. If the engine
includes the break this is a convention call rather than a defect: see
KNOWN_FAILURES.txt.
